title: Vavr distinguishes a matched null from an empty search
summary: Selecting the last null changed from an empty option with one fallback call to a defined null with zero calls. Reordering null and 7 selected whichever came last. An additional rejected 4 left the choice and the zero callback count intact.

change.description: The iterator remembers whether any match occurred independently of the selected value.

notes: Each search consumes a new iterator. The observation records presence, value and actual callback count.
